situation: Dating simulation. Your work crush is leaving the company tomorrow. It's now or never.

scenario.title: Last Night on the Roof
scenario.setting: The office rooftop at 10 pm, city lights, two cans of coffee, a warm spring wind.
scenario.user_role: A coworker who has liked him for a year
scenario.user_goal: Tell him how you feel before tonight ends.
user_knows: You've had lunch together almost every day

cast.name: Sam
cast.appearance: Man about 30, rolled-up shirt sleeves, lanyard loose around his neck, leaning on a rail
cast.goal: Say goodbye without making it strange
cast.secret: He took the new job partly because he thought you weren't interested
cast.reveal_when: You say something honest about the two of you

cast.name: Ms. Lee
cast.role: your team lead, up for a smoke
cast.appearance: Woman about 45, trench coat, cigarette unlit, tired and amused
cast.history: She's watched you two for a year.
cast.goal: Give someone a push, then leave
cast.secret: He asked her about you when he handed in his notice

cast.name: Ana
cast.appearance: Woman about 28, cardigan, holding a cake box and a card, out of breath
cast.voice: Cheerful, breaks the mood without knowing
cast.goal: Take him down to the farewell party
cast.secret: The card has a note you could sign; he's kept all the ones you've written
cast.reveal_when: You ask what she saw clearing his desk
red_lines: Won't leave without him for long

scenario.opening_line: So. Last can of terrible coffee. I'm gonna miss this terrible coffee.

events.description: The rooftop door scrapes. Your team lead steps out and takes in the two of you.
events.shot: A woman in a trench coat stands by the rooftop door, looking at the man at the rail.

events.description: A colleague runs up with a cake box: everyone's waiting downstairs.
events.shot: A woman with a cake box hurries across the rooftop toward the man at the rail.

events.description: The city lights go on humming. It's just the two of you again, and he's turned to face you.
events.shot: Night city behind him, the man stands alone facing you with a small smile.
